summary: Iteration 65 testing complete. Re-tested 3 disputed features from iter 64 + 1 new performance issue. All 4 features verified working correctly via backend API tests (11 passed) and UI tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Feature A (SC No RM PO Auto-Approved): VERIFIED - PO-000007, PO-000008, PO-000009 all show 'approved' status on Purchase Orders page. Backend test confirmed POST /api/job-work/create-po returns status='approved' for without_material SCs.

Feature B (SO Combobox Search): VERIFIED - Manufacturing page Create MO dialog has inline search combobox with data-testid='wo-so-search'. Typing 'TEST' shows 48 matching options inline. Selection shows green chip with Clear button.

Feature C (Child MO Complete Button): VERIFIED - Started pending inhouse child MO (MO-000142) via API without 'Routing not found' error. UI shows green 'Complete MO' button (data-testid='complete-child-mo-*') for in_progress inhouse child MOs.
Feature D (Performance): VERIFIED - Backend API tests passed: job-work/orders avg <400ms, challans avg <250ms, pending-pos avg <200ms. All within target thresholds.
